thread:
ajay: Heads up — running into mismatch between gateway-level transcoding and quota binding. If we transcode at the edge, we lose original proto metadata used to attribute tokens to tenant.

maria: oof. can you paste an example? what metadata specifically?

ajay: e.g. request has proto field `tenant_context { tenant_id: "acme" segment: "mobile" }` — when envoy converts to json it becomes body. We rely on x-tenant in headers for quota lookup but clients don't always send it.

sam: are we sure header mapping isn't enough? we can inject header from proto using xds route proto_to_header filter.

ajay: we tried that; works for unary but breaks streaming (grpc-web/HTTP2 long-lived), and adds ~1-2ms per request in our p95.

tasha: tradeoffs: do proto->header at route vs push to control plane to annotate traces? for billing we need consistency.

maria: could we require `x-tenant-id` on all public endpoints and fail fast? that simplifies quota and console UI but is a breaking change.

sam: also: proto has richer enums we use for routing (model_variant). Mapping to headers flattens them; downstream services expect typed enums.

ajay: alternative: keep a minimal edge translator that preserves metadata blob in `x-rw-meta` header as base64 protobuf. router can decode when needed.

maria: +1 for blob header, but concern: header size, rate limits, could hit 8KB limit on some proxies.

tasha: what about having gateway tag requests with `x-rw-lookup-id` that the control plane expands to metadata (lookup in redis). avoids big headers.

sam: that seems reasonable. latency penalty for a redis lookup though; but we can cache per-connection/token.

infra-bot: deploy-check: rolled out `edge-meta-blob` filter to canary (10% nodes) at 2026-03-19T15:12Z :thumbsup:

ajay: experiments show blob header adds 0.7ms median, 2.4ms p95. redis lookup path adds 4-6ms p95 but consistent.

maria: UX question — how should this show up in console? we want per-tenant cost + per-route model variant breakdown. if metadata is opaque, console needs to expand it in backend.

tasha: suggest control-plane expand on ingest, attach tags to traces and metrics. Console shows model_variant and tenant neatly.

sam: note: require changes in eval rollouts: if we fallback to text-json variant in some regions, tracing must show which protobuf field was lost so we can debug.

ajay: TL;DR proposal: push `x-rw-lookup-id` from gateway, control plane resolves to full proto, attach tags in ingestion pipeline. Keep blob header as emergency fallback.

maria: +1. let's write a tiny RFC and do canary tomorrow.

sam: agree. I'll sketch envoy xds filter and redis lookup details.

tasha: I'll update console ingestion contract.

ajay: thanks — filing RFC in #eng-platform-rfcs :link: (will post link when ready)
